newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Panda get approval for A share issue.
newsitem.headline: Panda get approval for A share issue.

text.p: Nanjing Panda Electronics Co Ltd has been given permission by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) to issue 23 million A shares and list them on the Shanghai bourse, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The issue has been tentatively priced at five yuan per share and will be traded on the Shanghai exchange in the near future, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter, the China Securities Bulletin.
Panda has also received approval from the CSRC to list five million staff shares, issued at one yuan per share in 1992, along with the A stock, the official said.
Shanghai Guotai Securities has been appointed main underwriter and listing promotor for the issue, the official said.
Panda currently has a total of 632.15 million outstanding shares, including 355.15 million state shares, 242.00 million H shares and 35 million employee shares, he said.
The H shares were issued at HK$2.13 per share earlier this year and listed in Hong Kong in May.

The official said Panda, headquartered in Nanjing, capital of the eastern province of Jiangsu, aimed to use the proceeds from the A share offer to increase output of colour televisions and manufacture digital video disks.
Panda is forecasting net 1996 earnings of 240 million yuan, compared with 170.73 million in 1995 and 136.57 million in 1994, according to international accounting standards, he added.
